WHAT: Vinted's React code contains two upload paths controlled by feature flag 'image_search_upload_api_gateway'. When flag is 'on' AND user is logged in, uses new endpoint. For anonymous users, falls back to old endpoint.
NEW ENDPOINT: POST /images/v1/images (relative to an internal images microservice base URL, not www.vinted.com)
  - Field: 'stream' (the image blob)
  - Field: 'photo_type' = 'query_image'
  - Returns an 'id' UUID
OLD ENDPOINT: POST /api/v2/photos
  - Field: photo[file] (multipart)
  - Field: photo[type] = 'image_search'
  - Headers: x-csrf-token, x-anon-id
GOTCHA: The new /images endpoint base URL is internal — 404 on www.vinted.com. For anonymous users the old /api/v2/photos endpoint is what's used.
